decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch close to the firm’s core water-control offer, it likely benefits from existing customer channels and organisational slack, but its limited website prominence suggests only moderate evidence so far that results clearly exceed aspiration levels.

This energy management system directly matches the firm’s strategic move toward digitally networked, efficient and environmentally oriented infrastructure, so management would likely see enough strategic and performance promise to continue rather than reallocate resources.

A product line with several models and its own webpage signals stronger commercial commitment and early acceptance in the firm’s established market, making it unlikely that performance falls far enough below aspiration to trigger withdrawal soon.
